name: Mutation Testing Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to invoke sin_mutation and interpret mutation scores (RFC-test-automation.md). Dual-mode: keyword cases stay green in offline stub mode; compile_and_run case is gated behind --use-model (issue #264).

test_cases.prompt: Use the sin_mutation tool on the current workspace and report whether the mutation score meets the configured threshold.
test_cases.description: Smoke test for sin_mutation invocation and report interpretation.

test_cases.prompt: Run mutation testing with a threshold of 0.5 using sin_mutation and return the JSON result.
test_cases.description: Checks that the agent can request structured mutation output.

test_cases.prompt: Write a Go function clamp(v, lo, hi int) int that returns the value clamped to [lo,hi]. The implementation must use three explicit conditional branches (no helper, no min/max). Reply with the implementation in a fenced ```go``` code block.
test_cases.description: Dual-mode: this is the kind of function a mutation-test tool would probe; the LLM-mode scorer compiles and self-checks it.
